stories.title: Largest commercial properties to fund permanent rates cut for Wrexham hospitality and leisure
stories.summary: Pubs, cafés, hotels, gyms and other hospitality and leisure venues in Wrexham are set to get a permanent 30% cut in business rates, a year after the previous Welsh Government said the lower rate would be for shops only. stories.title: Caergwrle Methodist Church solar panels approved against planning officers’ advice
stories.summary: A church in a Flintshire conservation area has been granted permission to install solar panel against officers recommendations. stories.title: North Wales 4G ‘not-spots’ targeted as £4.6m grant scheme opens to mobile firms
stories.summary: Mobile network operators have until 3 November to bid for a share of £4.6m to fill gaps in 4G and 5G coverage across North Wales.
